$comment: The gem-cut library (ticket 889, ME of the GD's Materials Expansion lock of 25 Oct: P&N's ~24-cut library replaces the earlier 12 per-act silhouettes). Each cut is one Blender stone rendered neutral on the ore stage (docs/art/gem-cuts) into a 256 px cell of the library's hue-tinted atlas pages, which follow every act's own hero pages; the terrain shader colours the cut by the gem's hue slot and lays the planet's overlay over it. Append-only: a cut is never removed, renamed or reordered, its cell is its place in this list (16 a page, `ground-gem-cut-atlas`, then `-page-<n>`), and `since` is the first ore rules version a planet must be stamped with to draw it, never below the version before it, so a cut added later waits for the next ore rules version and never moves the pick of a planet already generated (the gem-cuts spec pins picks for fixed addresses). `shape` is the stone the builder makes, for the README. Look only: no price, gate, income, save or digest reads it.
